offering_description.value: Owns and operates electric generation (mostly hydro), transmission and distribution utilities serving remote communities in Alaska, plus local telephone, broadband and internet services. Sells to residential, commercial and government customers through its own networks.

primary_services.value: retail electricity generation and distribution; local telephone service; broadband internet; long-distance and data transport

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electric, phone and internet subscribers in remote Alaska towns; B2B: commercial, industrial and mining customers, wholesale power buyers, carriers; B2G: local governments, schools and federal programs

end_markets.value: electric utilities; telecommunications; broadband; rural Alaska communities

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated electric rates and metered power sales, monthly telephone and broadband subscriptions; transaction or usage fees: long-distance, access charges and usage-based fees; other: government universal service support payments
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns hydro and diesel generation, power lines and telecom networks, sells to end users and wholesale buyers; service provider: provides telephone and internet access to rural subscribers

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeast, interior and western Alaska communities, some service in Washington state

specialization.value: related lines: electric utility and telecommunications serving the same remote communities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct service to subscribers over own networks and local offices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: regulated electric and telephone utilities under the Regulatory Commission of Alaska, FCC and FERC hydro licensing

notes: Details of current service areas and any out-of-state operations are from memory and may be incomplete.
